content.text: bin/biggest.sh reads the size from field 2 and the name from field 1, but names such as `holiday photos.tar` contain a space, so awk splits them: $2 becomes `photos.tar` (numeric value 0) and the real size in field 3 is never looked at. The largest entry is then picked from the wrong columns and `tests/run.sh` fails. A fix is to take the size from the last field (`$NF`) and the name as the line minus that trailing number. I changed nothing.
